plan.notes: No official term-by-term sequence is published for this program; the official Peru State program sheet lists requirements only. Recorded: required program prerequisites (9: CMIS 101, PSYC 121, SOC 201 - may also satisfy General Studies), Criminal Justice core (33), and Justice Administration option (24: select 8 of the listed courses). Official major total is 57 (core 33 + option 24); this plan totals 66 including the 9 prerequisite credits. A student must complete these in addition to the General Studies requirements (120 hours total for the degree); no grade lower than C- satisfies major requirements. Program sheet is for the 2024-2025 Undergraduate Catalog (BS/BA).
